title: Qt: IO Graph label precision, make scale factor a constant
description:
Pull out the scale factor used to convert the interval to seconds
to a constant so that it's easier to change in the future (#13682).

Fix the precision of the interval time displayed in the graph message.
We have the width of the interval, so we know exactly how many digits
after the decimal point to include, and we don't want to truncate
milliseconds, or truncate zeros at the end.

Add some comments for later addressing #13682.

Remove a comment about QTBUG-58699, as that's fixed upstream for
Qt 5.10, which is earlier than our minimum supported version.
